caption: The drawing features a grayscale depiction of a mission-style building identified as "Misión Santa Margarita" through labeled banners beneath the structure along with the date "1797." The main building is composed of a central entrance flanked by two arched openings on either side. The entrance is elevated and accessed by a wide, curved flight of stairs with railings on both sides. A simple cross sits atop the peak of the gabled roof, which has three circular openings and a quatrefoil window above the doorway. There are visible cracks along the façade and the supporting walls, suggesting age or wear. To the left of the main structure, an adjoining wall segment containing a large arched opening with a partial ledge is visible. The composition is rendered using fine lines and stippling for shading, and the entire drawing is in shades of black and white, with no color present. The artist's initials "RC" are placed beside the identifying label at the bottom.
title: Mision Santa Margarita
